assignments.name: days_since_published
assignments.value: ={{ (() => { const p=$json["published_at (Дата публікації)"]; const dt=p?DateTime.fromISO(p):null; return dt?.isValid ? Math.max(0,Math.floor(DateTime.now().diff(dt,'days').days)) : null; })() }}

assignments.name: demand_score
assignments.value: ={{ (() => { const p=$json["published_at (Дата публікації)"]; const dt=p?DateTime.fromISO(p):null; const d=dt?.isValid?Math.max(0,Math.floor(DateTime.now().diff(dt,'days').days)):999; const fresh=d<=7?25:d<=30?18:d<=90?10:3; const has=Number($json["budget_min (Мінімальний бюджет)"])>0||Number($json["budget_max (Максимальний бюджет)"])>0; const scope=$json.project_scope==='ongoing'?10:$json.project_scope==='pilot'?7:5; const conf=Math.round(Math.max(0,Math.min(1,Number($json.ai_confidence)||0))*20); return Math.min(100,35+fresh+(has?15:5)+scope+conf); })() }}
